posts.content:
Videos from Saildrone and NOAA capture choppy waves and stormy seas filmed by a drone, as Hurricane Isaias moves through the Gulf of Mexico toward Florida on Friday.
The Category 3 storm has grown into a major hurricane — the first of an unusually quiet Atlantic season — and is expected to make landfall Friday night.
[Video courtesy CNN]
